title: 사회대개혁위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:11:0:00011:part:1/1
title_original: 사회대개혁위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 11 (Handling of Matters on Which Advice Has Been Received)
(1) The Prime Minister may have the relevant central administrative agencies formulate implementation plans concerning matters resolved by the Committee.
(2) Where an implementation plan has been formulated pursuant to paragraph (1), the Prime Minister may have the relevant central administrative agency explain the results of its implementation to the Committee.
